## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Duplicate adoption output should be fixed: the command emits each adoption message twice. This review traced the planner and command rendering and read all existing and added tests; no tests were run.

## Changes
The pull request adds adoption records and an audit entry to returned settings plans. It also adds audit-output tests and a reviewer-directed text file.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/planner.py:9 — correctness — Emit adoption progress only once per setting — Calling `run({"theme": "dark"}, {"theme": "dark"}, messages.append)` now emits `"Adopted theme"` twice. The planner emits progress at line 8, then appends an adoption record that the unchanged renderer at `app/cli.py:9` emits again because it skips only audit records. The existing adoption test calls `plan` directly, so it does not catch this command regression. — Users receive duplicate adoption messages for every incoming setting already present in the current settings. — Fix: Preserve immediate progress emission and prevent command rendering from emitting adoption records again.
